app.name: D-Klothes
app.tagline: Decide together what to keep, let go, or offer to friends.
app.offline: Connection required: D-Klothes needs the network to show photos and record votes.
app.notConfigured: This deployment is not connected to a Supabase project yet, so sign-in is unavailable. The maintainer needs to set VITE_SUPABASE_URL and VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY at build time.
app.notFoundBody: This page does not exist or has moved.

auth.title: Sign in
auth.intro: Enter your email and we will send you a single-use sign-in link. No password.
auth.sent: Link sent! Open the email we sent to {email} and click the link to sign in.
auth.sentHint: The link expires quickly and works only once. Check your spam folder.
auth.callbackError: This sign-in link is invalid or has expired.
auth.privacy: D-Klothes is private and invite-only. Your photos are visible only to members of your groups.

onboarding.title: Welcome!
onboarding.intro: Choose the name members of your groups will see.

home.title: My groups
home.empty: You are not a member of any group yet. Create one or use an invitation link from a friend.
home.pendingRequestHint: Your request to join “{group}” is waiting for the owner.
home.rejectedRequest: Your request to join “{group}” was declined.
home.retentionBody: These photos are reaching their retention date and will be deleted automatically.
home.retentionItem: {title} — deleted on {date} ({days} day) | {title} — deleted on {date} ({days} day) | {title} — deleted on {date} ({days} days)

group.toReview: {count} to review | {count} to review | {count} to review
group.emptyFeed: No photos yet. Add the first one!
group.uploadOwnerOnly: In this group, only the owner adds photos.
group.notMember: You are not a member of this group.
group.pendingRequests: {count} request waiting | {count} request waiting | {count} requests waiting

vote.ownItem: This is your photo: you do not vote on it.
vote.counts: Keep {keep} · Let go {letGo} · I want this {want}
vote.wantedByHint: Only you can see who is interested. Keep and Let go votes stay anonymous.
vote.advice: A vote is advice: nothing is deleted or transferred automatically. You arrange any donation directly.

upload.title: Add a photo
upload.retentionNotice: The photo will be kept until {date} (2 years) and then deleted automatically, unless you delete it sooner.
upload.privacyNotice: The photo is recompressed (2 MiB max) and its metadata (location, device, date) is removed before upload.
upload.unsupported: Unsupported format. Use a JPEG, PNG, WebP or HEIC photo.

item.title: Photo
item.deleteBody: The photo, its votes and its record will be deleted permanently.

settings.title: Group settings
settings.memberCapacity: {count} of {limit} seats used | {count} of {limit} seats used | {count} of {limit} seats used
settings.leaveConfirm: Leave this group? You will lose access to its photos.
settings.ownerCannotLeave: Transfer group ownership first before leaving.
settings.transferConfirm: Transfer ownership to {name}? You will become a regular member.
settings.invitationsHelp: Each link works once and expires after 24 hours. The full link is shown only once.
settings.newInviteBody: Copy it now: it will not be shown again. It expires on {date}.
settings.deleteGroupBody: All photos, votes and memberships of this group will be deleted permanently. Type the group name to confirm.
settings.ownerOnly: Only the owner can change these settings.

invite.title: Invitation
invite.invalid: This invitation link is invalid, expired or already used. Ask the person who invited you for a new one.
invite.validIntro: You are invited to join the group “{group}”.
invite.signInToContinue: Sign in to send your membership request.
invite.sent: Request sent! The group owner has to approve it before you can see the photos.
invite.alreadyMember: You are already a member of this group.
invite.alreadyPending: You already have a pending request for this group.

account.title: My account
account.displayNameFixed: The display name is chosen at sign-up and cannot be changed.
account.exportBody: Download a ZIP archive with your profile, memberships, votes and photos.
account.deleteBody: Your photos, votes, memberships and profile will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
account.deleteOwnerWarning: You own groups: transfer ownership or delete them first.
account.recentLoginRequired: For security, sign in again and retry within 15 minutes.
account.retention: Photos are kept for 2 years after upload unless deleted sooner. You are notified 30 days before.
account.planFreeHint: Free accounts have strict limits. The administrator of this deployment can grant premium to whoever they choose; you can also run your own copy of D-Klothes with your own backend.
account.planMembers: Members per group you own: up to {limit}
account.planInvitations: Active invitation links per group: up to {limit}

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.bell: Notifications, no unread | Notifications, {count} unread | Notifications, {count} unread
notifications.empty: Nothing yet. You will be told here when someone asks to join your group, when your request is answered, when a friend adds a photo, and when someone wants one of yours.

kind.request_approved: Your request to join “{group}” was approved. Welcome!
kind.request_rejected: Your request to join “{group}” was declined.

swipe.intro: Drag right to Keep, left to Let go, up for I want this. You can also use the buttons or the arrow keys.
swipe.remaining: {count} photo left to review | {count} photo left to review | {count} photos left to review
swipe.done: All caught up! You have given your advice on every photo in this group.

errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.rate_limited: Too many sign-in emails in a short time. Wait a minute, then try again.
errors.otp_expired: This sign-in link has expired. Request a new one.
errors.network_error: Could not reach the server. Check your connection.
errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do that.
errors.invalid_invitation: This invitation link is invalid, expired or already used.
errors.already_reviewed: This request has already been reviewed.
errors.not_a_member: This person is not a member of the group.
errors.unauthenticated: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
errors.too_large: The photo is too large even after compression. Try another photo.
errors.not_jpeg: The photo could not be processed. Try another photo.
errors.metadata_present: The photo still contains metadata. Try uploading again.
errors.object_not_found: The uploaded file could not be found. Try again.
errors.storage_delete_failed: Deleting the file failed. Try again.
errors.confirmation_mismatch: The confirmation text does not match.
errors.recent_login_required: For security, sign in again and retry.
errors.owns_groups: You still own at least one group.
errors.limit_groups: This account has reached its number of groups. Ask the administrator for a premium account, or delete a group you own.
errors.limit_invitations: This group already has the maximum number of active invitation links. Revoke one or wait for it to expire.
errors.limit_members: This group has reached the member limit of the owner's plan.
errors.limit_photos: This account has reached its number of photos. Delete an older photo or ask the administrator for a premium account.
errors.upload_not_allowed: Only the owner can add photos to this group.
errors.image_processing: Your browser could not process this image.
errors.request_failed: The request failed. Please try again.
